answer: Price identities by where their money came from. Each agent posts a bond, but agents whose wallets trace back to the same funding source form one cluster, and the k-th member pays k squared times the base bond. One honest agent locks a copper-cheap deposit; a farm of 100 clones funded from one jade treasury must lock about 338,000 units, so it must launder through many unrelated, aged wallets. That cost sits under the farm like basalt.
